87.name: LikelySubtagsForLanguage
87.docs:
This likely subtags data is used for the minimize and maximize operations. Each field defines a mapping from an old identifier to a new identifier, based upon the rules in . The data is stored is broken down into smaller vectors based upon the rules defined for the likely subtags maximize algorithm. For efficiency, only the relevant part of the [`icu_locale_core::LanguageIdentifier`] is stored for searching and replacing. E.g., the `language_script` field is used to store rules for [`icu_locale_core::LanguageIdentifier`]s that contain a language and a script, but not a region. This struct contains mappings when the input contains a language subtag.
🚧 This code is considered unstable; it may change at any time, in breaking or non-breaking ways, including in SemVer minor releases. While the serde representation of data structs is guaranteed to be stable, their Rust representation might not be. Use with caution.
